mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for September 16, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. At least 20 killed after Israeli-hit building in Gaza City collapses. Rescue workers say search for dozens of people hampered by lack of heavy machinery. This was reported by The Guardian. 2. The Palestinian school under siege - podcast. At least five pupils at a village school in the West Bank have been killed in the last year by settlers and soldiers. This was reported by The Guardian. 3. Israeli double-tap strike kills 15-year-old and paramedic in Gaza. A child has been killed in an Israeli double-tap strike as he rushed to help a paramedic wounded in an earlier attack. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 4. Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say. Dozens of people are missing beneath the rubble of a building hit by an Israeli strike last year, where some 10 families had been living. This was reported by BBC News. 5.
